items: validate returns error string arrays; reset clears by default; Form uses promise submit
Combobox returns objects by default; SelectionControlGroup infers array selection; standalone selection uses deep comparison
UList/UTreeview selectable=false by default; Treeview defaults single-leaf and omitted openOnClick infers selectable && !activatable
List models and Tree activated model are arrays; Stepper mandatory defaults force
DatePicker/DateInput emit Date; adjacent month dates hidden; TimePicker model is 24-hour string with 24-hour display and dial defaults
Same-day date range keeps both endpoints; multi-date order follows click order; no date-time-range toggle; year range is current year -100 through +52
Avatar/Icon default slot wins; Table default slot wins; BtnGroup keeps selection extension; NumberInput keeps decimal precision default
Overlay/Menu/Dialog closed content is lazy; standalone Overlay is non-modal and scrollStrategy defaults none
Temporary drawer closes on route changes by default; disableRouteWatcher opts out
RangeSlider default model [0,0] and step 0 means continuous decimals; FileInput single null/multiple []; FileUpload null
Menu hover delays 300/250 ms; Autocomplete clearOnSelect=false; Combobox hideNoData=true; closableChips=false
NumberInput preserves the default left/right split layout; explicit end is the additional layout mode
ColorPicker keeps black default; current alpha/mode/canvas implementation has 14/14 focused browser checks but is not source-hash bound and visual acceptance is false
OtpInput accepts letters; clearing emits undefined
Skeleton loading defaults false; default slot is content when not loading; without default slot the skeleton remains
Calendar and DatePicker omitted firstDayOfWeek default is disputed; preserve Sunday versus locale inference is not decided.

locallyDeclaredButInert.evidence: No props.eager read or forwarding in the complete SFC; API docs declare it.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: The card detects $attrs.href for clickability but renders props.as and does not use the shared route helper; route objects in to are not navigated or made active.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Use the existing router helper while preserving current tag/click/style defaults; test with Vue Router.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: The wrapper renders fixed previous/next controls and exposes only a default slot scope; it does not render the upstream named prev/next replacement slots.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Forward prev/next slots in the existing wrapper, verify fallback/scopes, and preserve current controls/styles.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: UColorInput is a text hex editor plus native color input. It does not provide VColorInput openOnFocus/menuProps/pickerProps/hidePip popover behavior or consume those props through a color picker child.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Implement the picker/menu contract as a focused batch with a public wrapper browser test and synchronized API/demo.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: The built-in action is click-only and the component does not declare or forward href/to into it; upstream binds both targets to its action button.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Route the built-in action through UiButton and preserve click:action; decide whether action slots own their route.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: The child group has next/prev navigation, but UExpansionPanels does not expose either method through its public ref.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Expose group next/prev with current disabled/mandatory rules; keep child registration unchanged.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: The public ref exposes selection, navigation and scrolling, but omits focus(location) for next/prev/first/last focus movement.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Expose focus(location) and verify disabled-item filtering and RTL.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: itemProps are bound to a div[role=treeitem]; to/href are not converted to links or passed through the shared route helper. Upstream renders VTreeviewItem over VListItem with link props.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Support itemProps.to/href through the shared router integration while preserving row keyboard/disabled behavior.

confirmedRemainingFeatures.statement: eager is declared publicly but never read or forwarded in the SFC, so it cannot affect mounted-content behavior.
confirmedRemainingFeatures.nextBoundary: Resolve this local extension by implementing eager or removing the inert declaration; this is not an upstream eager parity claim.

staleClaimsRejected: UColorPicker now has color model-family preservation, alpha, mode selection and canvas behavior; it remains pending because the current focused report is not bound to SFC hashes.
UOtpInput currently declares and binds placeholder, pattern, type, masked, focusAll and divider; the historical missing-placeholder candidate is stale.
URangeSlider currently declares and binds direction/reverse/noKeyboard/ticks/showTicks/start/end; historical gap notes are stale.
UContainer and UMain consume shared dimensions; URow consumes responsive alignment/dense; UThemeProvider consumes tag.
UChipGroup and UBtnToggle forward eight group slot fields, selected/selectedValues live refs and group methods; their focused report has no source hashes.
UTreeview consumes nested selection/open helpers, disabled keyboard filtering, selectors, search, returnObject and async loadChildren; its report lacks source hashes.
UCalendar uses interval/category/time helpers; its focused report has source hashes but visualAcceptance is false.

UWindow now has showArrows and prev/next slot forwarding; its local eager prop remains unconsumed. UWindowItem, UCarouselItem, UiTabsWindowItem, UNavigationDrawer, UStepperItem and UExpansionPanel have current disabled/lazy/ref protocols in focused reports; only exact hashes bind current code.
Overlay/Menu/Dialog current lifecycle/focus/activator/sizing/non-modal behavior must be assessed from current SFC and hash-bound focused report, not historical gap lists.
UTable exposes default/caption content according to the current UiTable source.

Picker/menu/openOnFocus protocol and current-hash public browser report.

checks.nativeSimpleSelect: Simple label/value items retain the native select path and update the model.
checks.extendedSelect: Extended UiSelect is select-only, flattens nested groups, keeps disabled props on item slots, uses title with a legacy label fallback, and selects the raw item exactly once.
checks.disabledKeyboardSkipping: Disabled first row is skipped for active-descendant and Enter selection.
checks.nullReset: Reset restores a null model and the component remains usable.
checks.standardFiltering: customKeyFilter and filterKeys work with intersection/union modes; noFilter returns every item.
checks.objectComparator: returnObject selections use the existing deep comparator to match structurally equal objects.
checks.standardDefaults: Autocomplete preserves its default search after selection; chips are not closable unless closableChips is explicitly enabled.
checks.controlledModelsAndFocus: Controlled search/menu models update, single selection closes the menu, and focused emits without Vue warnings.
checks.selectionSlots: selection slots receive one raw item/index each; selection-summary retains the old aggregate items payload.
checks.comboboxProtocol: Configured delimiters create trimmed values, clearOnSelect and hideNoData use the standard defaults, blur commits free text, and removed object items keep their raw title.
checks.scopedLocale: Explicit $vuetify.noDataText resolves from the nearest provider and updates when its locale changes.
checks.clearAndFocus: Clear emits click:clear, resets the model, and restores input focus.
checks.closableChipOverride: Explicit closableChips=true removes a single-value chip and emits item:removed.

checks.nativeSimpleSelect: Simple label/value items retain the native select path and update the model.
checks.extendedSelect: Extended UiSelect is select-only, flattens nested groups, keeps disabled props on item slots, uses title with a legacy label fallback, and selects the raw item exactly once.
checks.disabledKeyboardSkipping: Disabled first row is skipped for active-descendant and Enter selection.
checks.nullReset: Reset restores a null model and the component remains usable.
checks.standardFiltering: customKeyFilter and filterKeys work with intersection/union modes; noFilter returns every item.
checks.objectComparator: returnObject selections use the existing deep comparator to match structurally equal objects.
checks.standardDefaults: Autocomplete preserves its default search after selection; chips are not closable unless closableChips is explicitly enabled.
checks.controlledModelsAndFocus: Controlled search/menu models update, single selection closes the menu, and focused emits without Vue warnings.
checks.selectionSlots: selection slots receive one raw item/index each; selection-summary retains the old aggregate items payload.
checks.comboboxProtocol: Configured delimiters create trimmed values, clearOnSelect and hideNoData use the standard defaults, blur commits free text, and removed object items keep their raw title.

checks.nativeSimpleSelect: Simple label/value items retain the native select path and update the model.
checks.extendedSelect: Extended UiSelect is select-only, flattens nested groups, keeps disabled props on item slots, uses title with a legacy label fallback, and selects the raw item exactly once.
checks.disabledKeyboardSkipping: Disabled first row is skipped for active-descendant and Enter selection.
checks.nullReset: Reset restores a null model and the component remains usable.
checks.standardFiltering: customKeyFilter and filterKeys work with intersection/union modes; noFilter returns every item.
checks.objectComparator: returnObject selections use the existing deep comparator to match structurally equal objects.
checks.standardDefaults: Autocomplete preserves its default search after selection; chips are not closable unless closableChips is explicitly enabled.
checks.controlledModelsAndFocus: Controlled search/menu models update, single selection closes the menu, and focused emits without Vue warnings.
checks.selectionSlots: selection slots receive one raw item/index each; selection-summary retains the old aggregate items payload.
checks.comboboxProtocol: Configured delimiters create trimmed values, clearOnSelect and hideNoData use the standard defaults, blur commits free text, and removed object items keep their raw title.
checks.scopedLocale: Explicit $vuetify.noDataText resolves from the nearest provider and updates when its locale changes.
checks.clearAndFocus: Clear emits click:clear, resets the model, and restores input focus.
checks.closableChipOverride: Explicit closableChips=true removes a single-value chip and emits item:removed.
checks.virtualizationAndUnmount: A 160-item list renders a bounded window, keyboard active-descendant scrolls into the window, and conditional unmount removes the consumer.
checks.console: No browser errors or Vue warnings.

checks.nativeSimpleSelect: Simple label/value items retain the native select path and update the model.
checks.extendedSelect: Extended UiSelect is select-only, flattens nested groups, keeps disabled props on item slots, uses title with a legacy label fallback, and selects the raw item exactly once.
checks.disabledKeyboardSkipping: Disabled first row is skipped for active-descendant and Enter selection.
checks.nullReset: Reset restores a null model and the component remains usable.
checks.standardFiltering: customKeyFilter and filterKeys work with intersection/union modes; noFilter returns every item.
checks.objectComparator: returnObject selections use the existing deep comparator to match structurally equal objects.
checks.standardDefaults: Autocomplete preserves its default search after selection; chips are not closable unless closableChips is explicitly enabled.
checks.controlledModelsAndFocus: Controlled search/menu models update, single selection closes the menu, and focused emits without Vue warnings.
checks.selectionSlots: selection slots receive one raw item/index each; selection-summary retains the old aggregate items payload.
checks.comboboxProtocol: Configured delimiters create trimmed values, clearOnSelect and hideNoData use the standard defaults, blur commits free text, and removed object items keep their raw title.
checks.scopedLocale: Explicit $vuetify.noDataText resolves from the nearest provider and updates when its locale changes.
checks.clearAndFocus: Clear emits click:clear, resets the model, and restores input focus.
checks.closableChipOverride: Explicit closableChips=true removes a single-value chip and emits item:removed.
checks.virtualizationAndUnmount: A 160-item list renders a bounded window, keyboard active-descendant scrolls into the window, and conditional unmount removes the consumer.
checks.console: No browser errors or Vue warnings.

checks.nativeSimpleSelect: Simple label/value items retain the native select path and update the model.
checks.extendedSelect: Extended UiSelect is select-only, flattens nested groups, keeps disabled props on item slots, uses title with a legacy label fallback, and selects the raw item exactly once.
checks.disabledKeyboardSkipping: Disabled first row is skipped for active-descendant and Enter selection.
checks.nullReset: Reset restores a null model and the component remains usable.
checks.standardFiltering: customKeyFilter and filterKeys work with intersection/union modes; noFilter returns every item.
checks.objectComparator: returnObject selections use the existing deep comparator to match structurally equal objects.
checks.standardDefaults: Autocomplete preserves its default search after selection; chips are not closable unless closableChips is explicitly enabled.
checks.controlledModelsAndFocus: Controlled search/menu models update, single selection closes the menu, and focused emits without Vue warnings.
checks.selectionSlots: selection slots receive one raw item/index each; selection-summary retains the old aggregate items payload.
checks.comboboxProtocol: Configured delimiters create trimmed values, clearOnSelect and hideNoData use the standard defaults, blur commits free text, and removed object items keep their raw title.
checks.scopedLocale: Explicit $vuetify.noDataText resolves from the nearest provider and updates when its locale changes.
checks.clearAndFocus: Clear emits click:clear, resets the model, and restores input focus.
checks.closableChipOverride: Explicit closableChips=true removes a single-value chip and emits item:removed.
checks.virtualizationAndUnmount: A 160-item list renders a bounded window, keyboard active-descendant scrolls into the window, and conditional unmount removes the consumer.
checks.console: No browser errors or Vue warnings.

checks.name: single-leaf defaults, openOnClick inference, and selected alias priority
checks.details: The tree defaults to a single-leaf strategy, selectable branches open on click, selected wins over modelValue, and selection emits both array aliases.

checks.name: multiple open strategy adds ancestors
checks.details: The public ref open method emits the opened item and its ancestor path through update:opened.

checks.name: legacy multiple cascade compatibility
checks.details: multiple=true without an explicit strategy retains the legacy all-selected-id array output.

checks.name: branch strategy and mixed state
checks.details: Explicit branch strategy returns its selected leaf plus its indeterminate branch ancestor.

checks.name: custom item selectors and itemProps disabled
checks.details: Function itemProps, dotted itemTitle, itemValue and itemChildren selectors are consumed; disabled items keep DOM/ARIA state and cannot be focused or selected.

checks.name: returnObject and custom valueComparator
checks.details: A comparator matches cloned model objects by key, and emitted selected arrays contain the original item objects.

checks.name: activated is opt-in and emits arrays
checks.details: activatable defaults false with no activation event; enabling it emits a one-item array.

checks.name: disabled and readonly guards
checks.details: Top-level disabled removes row interaction; readonly keeps the row but blocks selection.

checks.name: search filterKeys and customFilter
checks.details: Custom filtering uses the selected nested key and reveals matching descendants with their ancestor path.

checks.name: keyboard sibling expansion and disabled navigation
checks.details: * expands every enabled sibling branch and End focuses the last enabled rendered treeitem.

checks.name: locale-aware RTL keyboard model
checks.details: Arabic locale reverses horizontal expand/focus and collapse behavior.

checks.name: lazy loader return and mutation protocols
checks.details: Returned child arrays and in-place item.children mutation both rebuild the public tree.

checks.name: lazy errors reach the title slot
checks.details: Rejected loadChildren calls clear pending state and expose the error to the existing title slot scope.

checks.name: stale lazy response invalidation
checks.details: Replacing an item with the same key invalidates the in-flight result and clears the pending marker.

checks.name: unmount lazy cleanup
checks.details: Unmounting with a pending lazy request does not apply its result or produce a browser error.

checks.name: UStepper disabled-item protocol
checks.details: Mandatory initialization, next/prev, dynamic disabled/value changes, all-disabled state, and parent disabled state use live item registration.

checks.name: UExpansionPanel disabled-item protocol
checks.details: Mandatory initial selection skips disabled panels; item/parent disabled guards update live; value changes re-register without stale item state.

checks.name: UTreeview disabled keyboard protocol
checks.details: Disabled nodes keep their DOM/ARIA representation with tabindex=-1 and are excluded from Home/End, arrow navigation, and focus targets.
